cgs.label: Napping with Dodoco
cgs.description: Klee has fallen asleep, curled up and hugging a Dodoco plush among crayons, drawings and red flowers. Use when Klee dozes off, takes a nap, is tucked into bed or is too sleepy to keep playing.

cgs.label: Teasing a Cat
cgs.description: Hu Tao crouches on a sunny rooftop with a mischievous grin, dangling a grass stalk in front of a black cat while a little ghost floats behind her. Use when Hu Tao plays with or teases a cat or another small animal, or lounges about outdoors up to mischief.

cgs.label: Flowers in the Forest
cgs.description: Nahida sits on a huge leaf in a sunlit forest, holding a bouquet of purple flowers, with a flower spirit and a tiny tree inside a glowing bubble beside her. Use when Nahida picks, holds or gives flowers, or rests peacefully among plants in a forest.

cgs.label: Before the Mirror
cgs.description: Venti, in a white shirt with his green hat set down, smiles at his reflection in an ornate mirror as he fixes his braids beside a vase of white flowers. Use when Venti gets dressed, tidies his hair, looks in a mirror or prepares for a special occasion indoors.

cgs.label: Caring for the Blade
cgs.description: The Raiden Shogun sits by a low table in a quiet room, wiping her drawn katana with a white cloth, a lacquered sword-care kit open beside her. Use when she cleans, polishes or inspects her sword, or sits in calm, disciplined solitude.

cgs.label: Autumn Maples
cgs.description: Kazuha smiles beneath falling red maple leaves, holding one leaf up to the light while a small white cat sleeps in the crook of his arm. Use when Kazuha admires autumn leaves, catches a falling leaf, or cradles a cat.

cgs.label: Sparklers at Night
cgs.description: Yoimiya crouches on a rooftop at night, grinning with a lit sparkler in her hand as fireworks burst in the sky behind her. Use when Yoimiya lights sparklers or watches or sets off fireworks after dark.

cgs.label: Sketching a Lily
cgs.description: Albedo holds up a clipboard with an ink sketch of a white lily, the real flower in his other hand, surrounded by lilies and alchemy flasks. Use when Albedo sketches, draws or paints, or studies a flower or specimen closely.
